notes.title: The demo is now available in 17 languages!
notes.content:
In addition to the original English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, the demo now supports Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish-Spain, Portuguese-Portugal, Portuguese-Brazil, Spanish-Latin America, Dutch, Turkish, Ukrainian, Russian, and Vietnamese, bringing the total to 17 languages as listed on the store page!

There may be some oversights in the localized content. Please feel free to point them out! You can leave your feedback in the "Language Feedback" section of the game’s Steam discussion forum. The link is:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3228660/discussions/1/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3228660/discussions/1/[/url]

notes.title: The demo version of "Brilliant Jigsaw" is now available!
notes.content: The demo version of "Brilliant Jigsaw" has been released ahead of the Steam Next Fest! Various puzzles and interesting "abilities" are waiting for you to experience! A new player guidance voice has been added and can be enabled or switched between Chinese and English in the options

notes.title: Brilliant Jigsaw Game is scheduled to be released by the end of this year!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Brilliant Jigsaw Game will participate in Steam Next Fest 2024 in October, categorized under strategy and puzzle genres. The demo will be available before October 14th and will remain playable until the end of this Steam Next Fest 2024. During this period, the demo is free! Add it to your wishlist now to get first-hand information. After Steam Next Fest 2024, based on feedback, the game will be released by the end of this year. Stay tuned!
